page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening) with running text in one column; a braced diagram of boxes within the text; running head at top; page number at top centre. Left edge shows part of the facing left page with fragments of marginal notes (not transcribed as they are cut off and illegible).

main_text.p: nem angelorum (Christo, etiam homini seruientiū, & per ipsum hominem descendentium & ascendentium figurabat. Esa.6. cum Ioa. 1. 51. inter se comparatis.
Sanctum sanctorum, erat Tabernaculum secundum intra velum.Exod.26.33.34.Heb.9.2.3.
Figurabat autem cœlum ipsum, in quod semel ingressus (Christus, sedet in æternum, æternam redemptionem nactus.

Arca erat e lignis Shittim, longitudine sua duorum cubitorum ac dimidiati, & vnius cubiti ac dimidiati latitudine sua, altitudine vnius cubiti ac dimidiati, auro intrinsecus & extrinsecus obducta. Exod.25.10.11.
main_text.l: Huius consid. { Partes. } Collocata in ea testimonium cum alijs adiunctis.
main_text.p: Annuli erant quatuor aurei quatuor arcæ impagibus inditi : duo in vno latere, & duo in altero. ver. 12.
Vectes, e lignis Shittim & obducti auro, & immobiliter

page.notes: Braced diagram lines rendered as <l> boxes; the braces and their references (Heb.9.4; ver.15; 16.17; ver.12.13) are marginal/inline references. Opening words of the first line are partly cut off at the gutter. Some words in braces are uncertain (e.g. "Shittim" spelled "lhittim" in print). Left page fragments are not transcribed.
